requestedIntent: Owner decision 2026-10-27: end-user screens are built for the end user. Host end-user profiles (separate from permission roles), a target-user line in intake/slice/review brief, a product-language rule (no process/evidence text on screens, needed information shown briefly, user-facing text and agent notes in separate fields), a clarification that content assertions verify data and behaviour rather than disclaimer sentences, a review section and question, an optional warn-only hint script, and a clean-context user-goal tour that is a pre-check and not real user testing.

docs: method/SLICE_LANE.md#Screens are for the end user (owner decision 2026-10-27)

limitations: Wired, not enforced: nothing blocks a slice without the target-user line, a review that skips section F, or a screen that shows process text; the templates and the review ask for them, and selfcheck only checks that the template fields exist.

The hint script is a heuristic and only warns (exit 0): it sees quoted literals and text between tags on added lines, not rendered pages or text that comes from the database, so raw agent notes rendered from a record field are found only by review F4 and the goal tour.
Term matching is case-insensitive at word start with dotted/dotless I folded both ways; Turkish casing and morphology are approximated, not exact.
Profiles are assumptions written by the coordinator; the user-goal tour is an agent role-playing a user, not real user testing.
Effect not measured: the pilot in docs/slice-lane/product-language-pilot.md has not run; no host has a profile file yet.

evidence.note: 2026-10-27: 27 checks passed (warn-only exit codes, profile list drives hints, --profile scoping, placeholders ignored, long text, docs skipped, test files labelled, Turkish I folding, git mode with slice-method.json user_profiles).
